subject: Aaron Olapade School Committee Platform
overview: Aaron Olapade presented his platform for the Medford School Committee, detailing his personal background and policy goals. His priorities include creating safe learning environments, advancing educational equity, and fostering community collaboration.

items.title: Introductory Remarks and Personal Background
items.summary: Olapade shared his personal history as a Medford High graduate and described the formative experience of campaigning for public office as a young person.

items.title: Priority One: Safe and Supportive Learning Environments
items.summary: The candidate pledged to advocate for necessary resources, including facilities and books, alongside expanded mental health and social-emotional growth tools for students.

items.title: Priority Two: Equity and Inclusion
items.summary: Olapade proposed addressing systemic barriers by making extracurricular activities more accessible and recruiting a more diverse teaching staff.

items.title: Priority Three: Support for Educators and Community Collaboration
items.summary: The platform emphasizes fair compensation for staff and the creation of structured partnerships between schools and local Medford organizations.

items.title: Request for Campaign Support
items.summary: The presentation concluded with a request for financial contributions and volunteer assistance to support the campaign ahead of the November election.
